context: Show the slow-cooking of sambal so viewers see the effort behind the taste.

shots.description: Close-up of chillies sizzling in the wok, with sound on.
You stirring the sambal, wide shot of the kitchen behind.
Spoon lifting thick sambal, slow motion.
Plated nasi lemak with text: "Order before 9 PM".

context: Make the lunch set look irresistible and state the price clearly.

shots.description: Top-down shot of the empty tray, set items drop in one by one.
Close-up of crispy chicken being placed, then the egg.
Pour sambal over the rice.
Price text "RM 12.90 – today only" over the finished set.

context: Give a behind-the-scenes look at the morning rush to build a personal connection.

shots.description: Time-lapse of you opening the stall at sunrise.
Steaming rice and coconut milk being prepared.
Customers lining up, quick cuts of orders being packed.
You speaking to camera: "Subscribe for weekly recipes".

context: Capture an honest first-bite reaction to the new Sambal Udang dish.

shots.description: Customer looks at the plate, you say "Try this!".
Close-up of the first bite and their reaction.
Thumbs-up and text overlay: "Use code TASTE10".

context: Show the Friday bundle so office workers can picture sharing it.

shots.description: Two sets and two drinks placed side by side on a table.
Two people unwrapping and digging in at an office desk.
Price card "RM 28 bundle" and booking deadline text.

context: Teach one simple recipe so viewers return for more.

shots.description: Finished coconut rice as a hook with text "3 steps".
Step 1: rinse rice and add coconut milk.
Step 2: add pandan and salt, start the cooker.
Step 3: fluff the rice, then ask viewers to subscribe.

context: Show care in packing to build trust in your delivery quality.

shots.description: Order slip printed, you read the name aloud.
Top-down shot of the box being packed and checked.
Box sealed with a sticker, text "Order now, link in bio".

context: Let a real customer explain why they keep coming back.

shots.description: Customer at the counter introducing themselves.
Customer answering "What's your favourite set and why?".
Shot of them eating, with their name and quote as text.

context: Introduce yourself and answer viewer questions to deepen loyalty.

shots.description: You at the kitchen counter introducing the Q&A.
Answer 2–3 questions, cutting to b-roll of cooking between answers.
Ask viewers to comment their next question.
